item.title: Truzon Solar Ropes In Sachin Tendulkar To Boost Solar Uptake

item.description: Waaree Transpower, a transformer manufacturing and power equipment company within the Waaree Group, has achieved a major milestone by securing IDT orders exceeding INR 100 crore within the first month of launch. The orders, aggregating 1275 MVA (1.27 GW), have been placed by a Solar EPC company for deployment across high-capacity solar projects nationwide. item.title: Borosil Renewables’ German Unit Geosphere Glassworks Files For Insolvency
item.description: Indian solar glass manufacturer Borosil Renewables said on Tuesday that its wholly owned German subsidiary, Geosphere Glassworks GmbH, has filed an application to commence voluntary insolvency proceedings in Germany. The company cited a dearth of resources to meet a subsidy-related claim. item.title: PM-KUSUM: Sahaj Solar Gets ₹125 Cr Loan from IREDA For Solar Projects Across Four States
item.description: Gujarat-based Sahaj Solar has entered into a Loan Agreement with the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited (IREDA) to avail a ₹125 crore medium-term loan on December 18, 2025. Sahaj Solar said in a regulatory filing that it will use the facility to execute 15,000 solar pumps under PM-KUSUM Components B and C, as well as 300 off-grid SPV plant projects in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Punjab. item.title: REMCL Awards 10-Year O&M Contract To POWERCON For Rajasthan Wind project
item.description: Rail Energy Management Company Limited (REMCL) has awarded a long-term operations and maintenance (O&M) contract to POWERCON for its 26-megawatt wind power project in western India, the companies said on Tuesday. The contract, effective Dec. 16, runs for 10 years and covers REMCL’s wind farm at Dangri in Jaisalmer. item.title: Vikran Engineering Secures ₹2,035 Cr EPC Order for 600 MW Solar Project in Maharashtra
item.description: Mumbai-based Vikran Engineering Limited (VEL), a multi-sector EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) company, has received a ₹2,035.26 crore work order from Onix Renewables Limited, a special purpose vehicle (SPV). In a press release, Vikran stated that it will develop 600 MW of AC solar power projects across multiple locations in the state of Maharashtra.
